say:9:1622413007:1.source_cn: 是科丝蒂最近被选为宫廷魔法师的事。

say:10:1622413008:1.text: I'm so proud of her—of course I am. But her traveling to Savannah alone... it keeps me up at night.

say:11:1622413009:1.text: The royal court isn't a place where knowledge alone carries you. You need to understand people—manners, nuance... how to read a room.
say:11:1622413009:1.source_cn: 宫廷那种地方，不光看学问，还要明白人情世故，懂察言观色。

say:12:1622413010:1.text: And Cassadee... You know how she is...
say:12:1622413010:1.source_cn: 可科丝蒂她……唉，你们也知道……

say:14:1622413011:1.text: Riels says the same thing, but I still can't put my heart at ease.
say:14:1622413011:1.source_cn: 唉，里尔斯也常这样安慰我，可我还是放心不下……

say:16:1622413014:1.source_cn: 我理解你的担忧，父母总想为孩子挡住所有风雨。

say:17:1622413015:1.text: Still, I've had my share of learning how to survive in a place that isn't yours.
say:17:1622413015:1.source_cn: 不过，说起适应新环境这件事，我倒是有些经历可以分享。

say:24:1622413022:1.text: The entire clan knew braving the storm was a gamble, but it would mean a lot worse if a powerful enemy caught up to you.
say:24:1622413022:1.source_cn: 每个人都明白，穿越风暴或许能活，但若被强敌追上……等待...

say:28:1622413026:1.text: Do you really think staying at Cassadee's side every second will help her grow?
